answer_1.quote: we propose a novel method for document-level claim extraction and decontexualisation for fact-checking, aiming to extract salient check-worthy claims from documents that can be understood outside the context of the document.
answer_1.outputs: decontextualised claims that are salient and check-worthy

answer_2.quote: We use the chrF as the evaluation metric. The chrF computes the similarity between texts using the character n-gram F-score.

answer_4.quote: we asked a fact-checking professional to evaluate the quality of extracted sentences on the following two dimensions: 1) IsCheckWorthy: is the sentence worth checking? 2) IsCentralClaim: is the sentence related to the central idea of the article?
answer_4.guideline: 1) IsCheckWorthy: is the sentence worth checking? 2) IsCentralClaim: is the sentence related to the central idea of the article?
